subject: Request/response capture — procurement checklist and contract language
messages:
From: S. Mendez <smendez@brightbank.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Security (BrightBank) <security@brightbank.com>, procurement@brightbank.com
Date: 2025-06-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Data capture — default horizons and documentation request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profiling. Before we proceed to signatures, procurement/security asked for one last clarification to add to the MSA: we need a concise statement about what is captured by default (prompts, final model outputs, streamed fragments, KV cache/short-term artifacts) and the default retention windows for each.

Specifically BrightBank would like:
- A short clause that says what is stored by default and why (e.g., telemetry, debugging, quality improvement).
- The default retention period(s) for each category.
- Evidence we can reference for proof-of-deletion or a sample retention matrix.

Could you send a short Q+A and a redline we can attach to our contract packet? Also include any options for zero-retention or customer-managed retention for regulated workloads.

Best,
Sam
Procurement — BrightBank

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: S. Mendez <smendez@brightbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data capture — default horizons and documentation request

Hi Sam,

Thanks — looping in Kimberly (product/legal) and Karthik (security) to make sure we give procurement exactly what they need. Quick summary below; attaching a redline we can add to the MSA and a retention matrix PDF for your packet.

Short answers (for the MSA addendum):
- What is captured by default: request payloads (user prompts), model responses (final outputs), minimal telemetry (request/response metadata such as latency, error codes), and transient streaming fragments used to assemble responses.
- KV cache: treated as an ephemeral runtime artifact; not written to long-term stores by default.
- Default retention windows: prompts and final responses — 45 days by default in hosted deployments; telemetry (metrics/traces) — 90 days by default; streamed fragments and runtime KV cache — ephemeral (purged within 24–72 hours unless explicitly persisted by the customer). These defaults apply to Hosted API unless otherwise contracted.
- Opt-outs/contract options: customers can contractually require prompt-deletion-at-ingest (0-day retention) or longer retention as needed. Private deployments allow customer-controlled retention by default.

We can turn the above into a 3–4 sentence MSA clause and attach the retention_matrix_202506.pdf as evidence. Karthik — can you confirm wording around KV cache so we reference the purge window correctly?

Evelyn
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_msa_retention_clause_v1.docx, retention_matrix_202506.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: S. Mendez <smendez@brightbank.com>
Date: 2025-06-16T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data capture — default horizons and documentation request

Thanks — quick security clarifications for procurement's packet:
- KV cache: we never persist the per-request KV cache to long-term blob storage in hosted environment. The runtime keeps the cache in GPU memory and short-lived RAM; any cached slices written to disk (for horizontal scaling/failover) are encrypted and automatically swept within 24 hours unless the customer requests persistence.
- Streamed fragments: our streaming buffer is periodically flushed; fragments are not indexed and are eligible for purge within 48 hours by default.
- Evidence: attached retention_matrix_202506.pdf includes representative purge timestamps and the audit-log artifact names we can provide for proof-of-deletion. For formal erasure evidence the legal team issues a deletion certificate referencing internal job IDs — that process is listed in the MSA addendum.

Kimberly — legal suggested a short hook in the MSA referencing the longer retention matrix as a schedule. I drafted the redline accordingly (see attachment).

Karthik
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: S. Mendez <smendez@brightbank.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-17T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data capture — default horizons and documentation request

Hi Sam — attaching a redline for the MSA. Key points we added to the clause:
1) Definitions: explicit definitions for "Prompt" (user-submitted text), "Generated Output" (model responses), "Streaming Fragments" (interim token buffers), and "Runtime Cache" (KV cache).
2) Default retention: we call out the Hosted defaults (Prompts + Outputs = 45 days, Telemetry/Traces = 90 days, Streamed Fragments & Runtime Cache = ephemeral 24–72 hours) and note that these are configurable by written amendment.
3) Customer options: ability to require prompt erasure-at-ingest (0 days) or to self-manage retention in Private deployments.
4) Evidence & audit: Redwood will provide deletion certificates and relevant audit-log references upon request; for regulated customers we include SOC 2 control mapping and optional on-demand deletion evidence.

If BrightBank wants separate retention numbers for EU vs US regions we can provide region-specific schedules. Sam — please let us know if procurement wants the 45-day default shortened to 30 days or requires the zero-retention opt-in before sign.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_msa_retention_clause_v1.docx

From: S. Mendez <smendez@brightbank.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@brightbank.com
Date: 2025-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data capture — default horizons and documentation request

Evelyn / team — this is perfect, thanks. Procurement will accept the clause as drafted pending two small asks: (1) change the hosted default for Prompts+Outputs from 45 days to 30 days, and (2) add a short sentence that "streamed fragments are not indexed and are purged within 72 hours unless explicitly persisted."

We also need the redlined MSA and the retention_matrix in one bundle for our internal reviewers. Can you please upload signed DocuSign copies and the matrix to the Drive link we sent earlier and ping procurement when done?

Once those two items are in place we'll move to countersignature.

Best,
Sam
Procurement — BrightBank
